name: Offline-First Synchronization and State Replication
description: Replicated state vocabulary, local operation log, causal ordering, idempotent replay, conflict taxonomy, merge policy registry, file and artifact synchronization, board state synchronization, presence versus durable state separation, attachment transfer, partial replication, device rejoin and catch-up, snapshot and compaction, offline mutation receipts, encryption in transit and at rest, multi-device simulation, partition testing, and sync repair tooling.
objective: Build offline-first synchronization with causal ordering, conflict resolution, and state replication across devices.
